Reported Q2 2026 results after market close: net revenue $196.6M (+28.8% YoY, beat ~$186M consensus); GAAP diluted EPS $0.15 (net income $28.4M) per company release, though some aggregators separately show $0.11 vs a $0.07 consensus; adjusted EBITDA $36.6M (18.6% margin, excluding $7.9M of IEEPA tariff refunds); raised full-year 2026 revenue growth outlook to ~20% (from 14-16%) and adjusted EBITDA margin guidance to 14.8-15.0%; flagged tariffs and a CBP withhold-release order on a key supplier as H2 gross-margin/inventory headwinds.

FIGS reported Q2 2026 results: net revenue $196.6M (+28.8% YoY), ~5.6% above ~$186.1M consensus; net income $28.4M ($0.15/diluted share GAAP) vs. $0.04 YoY; adjusted EBITDA $36.6M (18.6% margin, excluding a $7.9M IEEPA tariff refund); operating margin rose to 17.9% from 6.5% YoY; raised FY2026 revenue growth guidance to ~20% (from 14–16%) and adjusted EBITDA margin guidance to 14.8–15.0%; flagged tariffs and a CBP withhold-release order against a key supplier as H2 gross-margin/inventory headwinds
